consent.enableRequirement: This is unchecked by default. Operations are enabled only after you acknowledge the risks and agree below. Not Now still allows reviewing policies and managing existing local data.
consent.introduction: Read the risks, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy before enabling operations. Pairing credentials stay on the device and require separate processing consent.
consent.pairingMessage: Pairing credentials may contain device identifiers, certificates, and keys. They are used only to connect to your configured device and are stored locally. Exposure may affect device security. Connect only to devices you are authorized to manage.
consent.riskAcknowledgement: I have read and understood these serious risks, including possible system damage, data loss and incomplete recovery.
consent.riskAcknowledgementHint: Check this before selecting Agree and Enable. Checking it alone does not enable operations.
consent.riskBackup: Back up important data first. Select Not Now if you cannot accept device unavailability or data loss.
consent.riskDamage: Operations may corrupt system or wallpaper data, lose important data, break functions, crash the system interface, cause repeated restarts or prevent normal startup.
consent.riskMechanism: bad_query and worse_query access sandbox-external files through unintended system behavior. AirTraffic temporarily changes Books sync state. The Pocket Poster method uses a temporary .Trash link and the system file-move service. Failures, interruption or an incorrect destination can affect system data. These are not official wallpaper installation APIs.
consent.riskRecovery: Severe problems may require a system restore or reinstall that erases device data. Some data may be unrecoverable. Verification, backups and rollback do not guarantee complete recovery.
consent.title: Before You Begin
consent.withdrawMessage: Pairing, queries, and writes will be disabled. You can still browse and manage local data, and enable operations again after reviewing the policies.

neoSpring.automaticNotice: After wallpaper files are written and verified, NeoSpring will refresh the system interface automatically without asking each time. The screen may briefly go black, return to the Lock Screen, or close the app; the refresh may also have no effect. Save other work first. Turn this option off at any time. This does not reboot the device.
neoSpring.explanation: Use Review & Install Wallpapers above to install a pack. This section only refreshes the system interface.
neoSpring.manualNotice: NeoSpring will attempt to refresh the system interface to help load wallpaper changes. The screen may briefly go black, return to the Lock Screen, or close the app; the refresh may also have no effect. Save other work first and reopen the app if needed. This does not reboot the device.
onboarding.afterRestart: After restarting, reconnect LocalDevVPN before reopening Pawster. Your setup progress is saved here.
onboarding.alreadyInstalled: Already have LocalDevVPN or a working local VPN? Continue to check your connection.
onboarding.developerAcknowledgement: I enabled Developer Mode and confirmed it after restart, or it was already enabled
onboarding.developerConfirm: After restarting and unlocking, tap Enable in the system confirmation and enter your device passcode if prompted.
onboarding.developerPath: Open Settings, then Privacy & Security → Developer Mode. If you use the button below, first go back to the main Settings page.
onboarding.developerRestart: Turn on Developer Mode. Read the system notice, then tap Restart to confirm. If it is already enabled, you can continue.
onboarding.finishHelp: After setup, use Discover & Verify Path on the Connection tab to check the system connection, then import wallpapers.
onboarding.importHelp: Tap Import and look in Files → On My iPhone → SideStore → ALTPairingFile.mobiledevicepairing. You can also select a .mobiledevicepairing or .plist file exported from a computer or another pairing tool.
onboarding.installInstructions: Install LocalDevVPN from the App Store, published by Coxson Engineering LLC. Return to Pawster after installation.
onboarding.legacyPairing: This system cannot pair through Settings. Import a pairing file for this device, generated by a tool such as SideStore or on a computer and transferred to Files.
onboarding.localNetwork: If Pawster is not listed, check Local Network access in this app’s system settings and confirm the pairing session is still running.
onboarding.missingDeveloperHelp: This option may appear only after device pairing has been initiated. Follow Apple’s guide to pair the device with a computer, then return here. An existing SideStore pairing file can also be imported in the next step.
onboarding.pairPIN: Enter the six-digit code shown in the guide window or Pawster. Wait for the pairing success message, then return.
onboarding.pairSettings: Once the session starts, go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode and tap Pair with Pawster.
onboarding.pairStart: Tap the pairing button below. Allow local network access if iOS asks.
onboarding.reconnectVPN: The local VPN is not connected. Open LocalDevVPN and reconnect before pairing.
onboarding.savedReady: The saved pairing file passed the format check. Device trust will be checked when you query the connection.
onboarding.storeHelp: If the app is unavailable in your region, check its project page for guidance.
onboarding.title: Getting Started
onboarding.vpnAllow: When iOS asks to add a VPN configuration, tap Allow and enter your device passcode if prompted.
onboarding.vpnNotReady: A working local VPN route has not been detected
onboarding.vpnOpen: Open LocalDevVPN. For a first setup, keep its default network configuration and tap Connect. You can keep an existing working configuration.
onboarding.vpnOpenFailed: Could not open LocalDevVPN. Confirm that it is installed or open it from the Home Screen. Its download link is in step 1.
onboarding.vpnReturn: Wait for LocalDevVPN to show Connected, leave it connected, and return to Pawster. The status below updates automatically.
onboarding.vpnTitle: Configure and Connect the Local VPN
onboarding.vpnTrouble: If no connection is detected, confirm that LocalDevVPN shows Connected. With custom addresses, Pawster’s Peer IP should match LocalDevVPN’s Device IP. Choose Set Up Later to adjust it on the Connection tab.

pocket.historyHelp: This record does not prove installation and cannot roll back wallpapers or refresh registration preferences. Cleanup only handles this app’s temporary link and recorded local copies; it never deletes system wallpapers.
pocket.invalidTarget: Enter this device’s PosterBoard container UUID or full container root path. Other paths, JSON and pairing files are not accepted here.
pocket.manualHelp: Enter the PosterBoard container UUID or full root path for this device. Manual transfer needs no pairing or VPN; valid formatting does not establish container identity.
pocket.manualRefresh: This method cannot verify the target and does not trigger automatic refresh. Check system wallpapers first and refresh manually if needed; refresh behavior on older systems remains untested.
pocket.nuggetHelp: Copy the PosterBoard UUID output from an existing Pocket Poster / Nugget setup, or import the NuggetPosterBoardHash text file. The existing Nugget Helper does not automatically send it to Pawster.
pocket.optionalConnection: The connection settings below are optional for automatic path discovery. Manual UUID transfer does not require pairing, a VPN or an App Group.
pocket.optionalQueryHelp: If you do not have the UUID, configure LocalDevVPN and import pairing for this device, then find the container in Connection. This uses imported credentials, not native Settings pairing.
pocket.pathOnly: Destination saved. The target directory is not inspected; check the transfer result in system wallpaper Settings.
pocket.prepareCollections: If the destination directory is unavailable, check the UUID and add a Collections wallpaper normally in system Settings to initialize its directory.
pocket.retryMessage: First check the earlier attempt and system wallpaper collection. Another attempt may add duplicates. Confirmation only releases the local duplicate-attempt block and keeps the earlier record; it sends or deletes no wallpaper.
pocket.sent: System move request completed. Target files remain unverified; check system wallpaper Settings.
pocket.sourceNotMoved: The local copy remains after the system call; its move result could not be established.
pocket.stageChanged: The staging directory was replaced and ownership cannot be established. It was not deleted; preserve the record and inspect it.
